record_title: Transport-renormalized critical relaxation in a convective Chafee-Infante equation
provenance: Analytic energy, spectral, and center-manifold analysis of a one-dimensional convective Chafee-Infante equation with homogeneous Dirichlet data.
limitations: The sharp critical asymptotics exclude the strong-stable exceptional class; the post-threshold branch result is local; the global energy threshold uses homogeneous Dirichlet data; the gamma=-1 Burgers-Huxley interpretation is a symmetric-cubic mathematical extension rather than the standard physical parameter regime. Originality is to the best of our knowledge and retains residual risk from older model-specific sources not all inspected at full theorem level.
